weight_floor.scope: Weights-only streaming floor for the first68 captured routes; excludes books/gains/activations/output, assumes weights cross DRAM once. Not measured physical traffic.

limitations: First 68 verify calls only; exact selected routes, inputs, route weights and clamps.
Eight rotating synthetic 32-expert weight pools exceed L2; model weight values and physical layout differ.
Replay includes an input D2D warm copy and final reduction but no routing kernel.
Isolated hashes cover the last complete case; the focused fixture covers all row/count/format combinations.
NCU flushes caches and uses no clock override; requested L1 sectors are not physical DRAM traffic.
The assistant fixture is bounded supplementary performance evidence, not broad quality qualification.
The corpus continuation repeats near its tail; its MTP acceptance does not represent assistant workloads.
Chunked prefill is unchanged; its variation is not counted as another Prefill gain.
Final incremental 2K-64K sweeps and the token-level MTP state gate are recorded separately.
Ordinary assistant paired gains are +0.656%, +1.251%, -0.342%; median gain does not establish a uniform gain or speed equivalence.
One-row decode and prefill kernels are unchanged; final incremental sweeps qualify their absolute rates.
decision: Adopt D3: every fresh assistant/corpus pair improves with non-overlapping ranges, exact F32 proofs, lower target time and no new allocation; register cost leaves occupancy unchanged.
